answer_1.quote: We apply the concept of controlled neural text generation to the domain of argument generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated arguments (single sentences) for given topic, stance, and aspect.

answer_2.quote: Both the retrieval and generation approaches are evaluated against reference data from debate portals and compared via METEOR and ROUGE-L metrics.

answer_3.quote: We use the WA-score as label, the same model (BERT BASE) and hyperparameters as given in the original paper, and reproduce the reported correlations... The model predicts an average argument quality...

answer_4.quote: We conduct an expert evaluation on a subset of generated arguments with two researchers... Two aspects are evaluated: fluency and persuasiveness.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluate fluency as a binary task (grammatically correct) and persuasiveness by comparing pairs of generated and reference arguments.
